revisions.summary: First diagram: Electron main process, preload bridge, React renderer, and 4 data stores and tools, down to key functions.

components.name: Archive
components.purpose: A private, local desktop journal for macOS. The user writes Markdown entries with categories, a cover image, and media, and browses them offline.
components.data_in: Entry text, categories, image and video files, and settings from the user
components.data_out: Rendered entries, a SQLite database, copied media files, and a settings file on the local disk
components.notes: There is no server and no network sync. All data stays in ~/Library/Application Support/field-notes. There are no tests in the repository.
actors: The single local user, who writes and reads entries
external_services: ffmpeg (optional local binary, used to remux imported videos)
data_stores: blog.db: SQLite database with entries, media rows, categories, and revisions
media/: copied image and video files, named by UUID
settings.json: user name, quote bank, goals, and theme choice

components.name: ffmpeg
components.purpose: Optional command-line tool. The app uses it to move the moov atom of imported videos to the front of the file, so that they play through media://.
components.data_in: Source video path and output path
components.notes: Not bundled. The app looks in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, then PATH. Without it, videos are copied as they are and may not play.
components.start_deploy: Installed by the user, for example with Homebrew.

components.name: Media folder
components.purpose: Holds copies of every image and video the user imports. Database rows refer to these files by file name only.
components.data_in: Files copied or remuxed by importMedia
components.data_out: File bytes served through the media:// protocol
components.notes: Files are named <uuid><ext>. Files imported into a draft that is never saved stay on disk. A replaced or removed cover image file is not deleted until the post is deleted.

components.name: Settings file (settings.json)
components.purpose: Stores the user name, the quote bank, the goals list, and the theme choice between launches.
components.notes: A missing or broken file gives the default settings.
components.start_deploy: Created on the first settings save.

components.name: SQLite database (blog.db)
components.purpose: Stores all entries, their media rows, categories, the links between them, and the saved revisions of each entry.
components.data_in: SQL statements from src/main/posts.ts and src/main/db.ts
components.data_out: Rows of the post, media, tag, post_tag, and post_revision tables
components.notes: The tag table holds what the UI calls categories. The post.status and post.published_at columns are written but never read. Foreign keys are on, so deleting a post or tag cascades to media, post_tag, and post_revision rows.
components.technology: SQLite through better-sqlite3, WAL journal mode
components.start_deploy: Created on first launch by getDb. Columns added later are added by migrate.
interfaces: Tables: post, media, tag, post_tag, post_revision

components.name: Main process
components.purpose: The Electron main process. It owns the window, the app menu, the database, the media files, and the settings file, and it answers every IPC request from the renderer.
components.data_in: IPC invoke calls from the preload bridge, media:// requests from the renderer, menu clicks
components.data_out: IPC replies with PostDetail, PostSummary, Category, Revision, and Settings objects; media file bytes; menu events
components.notes: The app name is 'Archive', but userData is fixed to appData/field-notes so that a rename does not lose data. The window runs with sandbox: false.
components.technology: TypeScript, Electron 43, Node.js, better-sqlite3 13, @electron-toolkit/utils, built with electron-vite 5
components.entry_point: src/main/index.ts (built to out/main/index.js, the package.json main)
components.start_deploy: Run 'npm run dev' for development. 'npm run package' builds and makes an unsigned macOS app folder in dist/ with electron-builder.
interfaces: IPC: app:getVersion, theme:get, theme:set, settings:get, settings:update
IPC: posts:list, posts:getBySlug, posts:create, posts:update, posts:updateBrainstorm, posts:delete, posts:listRevisions, posts:getRevision, posts:revertToRevision
IPC: categories:list, categories:create, categories:rename, categories:delete, categories:reorder, categories:updateDescription, categories:setFavorite, categories:contextMenu
Events to renderer: menu:new-entry, menu:save, theme:updated
configuration: ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL (dev server URL, set by electron-vite in dev)

components.name: db.ts
components.purpose: Opens the single SQLite connection, creates the schema, runs column migrations, and gives the path of the media folder.
components.data_out: A shared better-sqlite3 Database object, the media folder path
components.notes: The SCHEMA string uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. New columns must also go into migrate, or existing databases will not get them.

components.name: getDb
components.purpose: Returns the one open database connection, and opens and prepares it on the first call.
components.notes: The connection is cached in a module variable and never closed.
components.side_effects: Creates the media folder; creates or opens blog.db; sets WAL and foreign_keys pragmas; creates tables
components.errors_handled: None (open errors are thrown to the caller)
key_logic: Return the cached connection if it exists.
Create <userData>/media if it does not exist.
Open <userData>/blog.db.
Turn on WAL journal mode and foreign keys.
Run the SCHEMA statements, then migrate.

components.name: getMediaDir
components.purpose: Gives the path of the folder that holds imported media files.
components.notes: It does not create the folder. getDb does that.
key_logic: Get the userData path from Electron.
Join it with 'media'.
Return the path.

components.name: migrate
components.purpose: Adds columns that later versions of the app need to databases made by older versions.
components.notes: There is no version number. Each step checks PRAGMA table_info for the column.
components.side_effects: ALTER TABLE on post, post_revision, and tag; one UPDATE of tag.sort_order
key_logic: Read the columns of the post table.
Add post.brainstorm and post.cover_image_caption when they are missing.
Add post_revision.cover_image_caption when it is missing.
Add tag.sort_order when it is missing, and set it to the tag id.
Add tag.description and tag.favorite when they are missing.

components.name: index.ts
components.purpose: Main process entry point. It sets the app name and data path, creates the window and menu, serves media:// URLs, and registers every IPC handler.
components.data_in: IPC invoke calls, media:// requests, app lifecycle events
components.data_out: IPC replies, HTTP-like responses for media, events to the renderer
components.notes: app.setPath('userData', appData/field-notes) runs before app ready. Changing it would hide all existing data.

components.name: buildMenu
components.purpose: Sets the application menu, including New Entry (Cmd+N) and Save (Cmd+S), which send events to the renderer.
components.data_out: menu:new-entry and menu:save events to the focused window
components.notes: Events go only to the focused window.
key_logic: Add the app menu on macOS.
Add File > New Entry, which sends menu:new-entry.
Add Edit, View, and Window menus with standard roles.
Add Entry > Save, which sends menu:save.
Set the menu as the application menu.

components.name: createWindow
components.purpose: Creates the main app window with the preload script and loads the renderer.
components.notes: sandbox is false. Links that try to open a new window open in the default browser instead.
components.side_effects: Opens a window; opens external links with shell.openExternal
key_logic: Create a 1200x800 window with a hidden inset title bar and a theme-matched background.
Show the window when it is ready to show.
Send new-window requests to the external browser and deny them.
Load ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL in dev, or the built index.html otherwise.

components.name: media:// protocol handler
components.purpose: Serves files from the media folder to the renderer, with HTTP range support so that video can seek.
components.data_in: Request for media://<fileName> with an optional Range header
components.data_out: Response with the file bytes, status 200 or 206, and Content-Type from the file extension
components.notes: An anonymous callback passed to protocol.handle('media'). It reads at most 8 MB per request with synchronous reads. This avoids an Electron race with streamed bodies that corrupts concurrent video range requests.
components.errors_handled: 403 for paths outside the media folder; 404 for a missing file; 416 for a bad or out-of-range Range header
key_logic: Take the file name from the URL host and resolve it inside the media folder.
Reply 403 when the resolved path leaves the media folder.
Reply 404 when the file does not exist.
Parse the Range header, and reply 416 when it is invalid.
Cap the byte range at 8 MB.
Read the bytes and reply 206 with Content-Range, or 200 for the full file.

components.name: app.whenReady handler
components.purpose: Starts the app when Electron is ready: restores the theme, opens the database, registers the media protocol and all IPC handlers, and opens the window.
components.data_in: IPC invoke calls with their arguments
components.data_out: IPC replies; theme:updated events to every window
components.notes: An anonymous callback passed to app.whenReady().then(). IPC handlers pass arguments straight through without checks. The categories:contextMenu handler shows a native Rename/Delete menu and resolves to the choice or null.
components.side_effects: Sets nativeTheme.themeSource; opens the database; registers the media protocol and IPC handlers; sets the app menu; opens a window
components.errors_handled: None. Errors thrown by handlers go back to the renderer as rejected promises.
key_logic: Set nativeTheme from the saved theme, and send theme:updated to all windows when it changes.
In dev on macOS, set the dock icon.
Open the database with getDb.
Register the media:// protocol handler.
Register one ipcMain.handle for each app, theme, settings, posts, categories, and media channel.
Build the menu and create the window.
On macOS activate, create a window when none is open.

components.name: media.ts
components.purpose: Copies image and video files that the user drops into the app into the media folder under a new UUID name.
components.notes: Supported: .jpg .jpeg .png .gif .webp .heic .avif .mp4 .mov .webm .m4v.

components.name: findFfmpeg
components.purpose: Finds a working ffmpeg binary, because apps started from the macOS GUI do not get the shell PATH.
components.notes: The result, including null, is cached for the life of the process. Installing ffmpeg later needs an app restart.
components.errors_handled: Ignores errors from each candidate and tries the next
key_logic: Return the cached result when there is one.
Try /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg, /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg, then ffmpeg on PATH.
Skip absolute paths that do not exist.
Return the first candidate that runs '-version' without error, or null.

components.name: importMedia
components.purpose: Imports one dropped file into the media folder and tells the renderer its new name and type.
components.data_in: Absolute source path from the renderer
components.notes: It does not write to the database. The file is linked to a post only when the post is saved.
components.side_effects: Writes a file into the media folder
components.errors_handled: Throws 'Unsupported file type' for unknown extensions
key_logic: Find the type from the file extension.
Throw an error when the type is not image or video.
Make a new file name from a random UUID and the lower-case extension.
Remux videos with importVideo, and copy images as they are.
Return the new file name and the type.

components.name: importVideo
components.purpose: Copies a video with its moov atom moved to the front, so that Chromium can play it through media://.
components.data_out: Video file at the destination path
components.notes: See electron/electron#38749. The remux is lossless and does not re-encode. It runs synchronously and blocks the main process during the remux.
components.side_effects: Runs ffmpeg; writes a temporary file and renames it
components.errors_handled: When ffmpeg is missing or fails, it falls back to a plain copy
key_logic: Find ffmpeg. When it is missing, copy the file and stop.
Run ffmpeg with -c copy -movflags +faststart into a temporary file.
Rename the temporary file to the destination.
On any error, copy the source file instead.

components.name: posts.ts
components.purpose: All database reads and writes for entries, categories, entry media, and revisions. Each exported function backs one IPC channel.
components.notes: Code says 'tag' for the table and 'category' for the concept. Most multi-statement writes are not in a transaction; only reorderCategories uses one. Entry list summaries run one category query per entry.

components.name: contentChanged
components.purpose: Decides if a save or revert changes the content, so that revisions are made only for real changes.
components.notes: Media and slug are not compared.
key_logic: Compare title, body, and cover image path exactly.
Compare excerpt, caption, and brainstorm with null treated as empty.
Compare categories without regard to order.
Return true when any field differs.

components.name: createCategory
components.purpose: Adds a category at the end of the sidebar order.
components.notes: When the name already exists, it returns the existing id with count 0, which can be wrong.
components.errors_handled: Duplicate names are ignored by INSERT OR IGNORE
key_logic: Trim the name.
Find the next sort_order (the highest plus one).
Insert the tag with a slug, unless the name exists.
Load the tag id by name and return it.

components.name: createPost
components.purpose: Saves a new entry with its categories and media.
components.notes: status is always 'published'. The three writes are not in one transaction.
components.side_effects: Inserts into post, tag, post_tag, and media
components.errors_handled: None. A duplicate slug throws a SQLite UNIQUE error, which the editor shows.
key_logic: Insert the post row with status 'published' and the current time.
Set its categories with setPostCategories.
Set its media with setPostMedia.
Load and return the entry by slug.

components.name: deleteCategory
components.purpose: Deletes a category. Its entries stay, but lose the category.
components.notes: post_tag rows are removed by cascade.
components.side_effects: Deletes a tag row and its post_tag rows
key_logic: Delete the tag by id.
Let the foreign key cascade remove its post links.

components.name: deletePost
components.purpose: Deletes an entry and the media files and cover image that belong to it.
components.notes: Files are deleted before the row. Cascades remove media, post_tag, and post_revision rows. Cover images named only in revisions are not deleted.
components.side_effects: Deletes files from the media folder; deletes the post row and cascaded rows
components.errors_handled: Ignores files that are already gone; does nothing for an unknown id
key_logic: Load the cover image path. Stop when the post does not exist.
Load the media file names of the post.
Delete each media file and the cover image file.
Delete the post row.

components.name: getPostBySlug
components.purpose: Loads one full entry with its body, brainstorm, categories, and ordered media.
components.data_out: PostDetail, or null when no entry has the slug
components.notes: Create, update, and revert also use it to return the saved entry.
components.side_effects: Reads post, media, post_tag, and tag
components.errors_handled: Returns null for an unknown slug
key_logic: Select the post row by slug.
Return null when there is no row.
Select its media rows in 'order' order.
Return the summary fields with body, brainstorm, and media.

components.name: getRevision
components.purpose: Loads the full content of one revision for preview.
components.notes: None
components.signature: getRevision(postId: number, revisionId: number): RevisionDetail | null
components.errors_handled: Returns null when the revision does not belong to the post
key_logic: Select the revision by id and post id.
Return null when there is no row.
Parse the categories JSON and return the detail.

components.name: listCategoriesWithCounts
components.purpose: Lists all categories with their entry counts in sidebar order.
components.data_out: Category[] with id, name, count, description, favorite
components.notes: None
key_logic: Left-join tags to post_tag and count the posts of each tag.
Sort favorites first, then by sort_order, then by id.
Convert favorite from 0 or 1 to a boolean.

components.name: listEntries
components.purpose: Lists entry summaries, newest first, for all entries or for one category.
components.data_in: Category id, or null for all entries
components.notes: Each summary runs a second query for its categories (N+1).
key_logic: When a category id is given, select posts joined to post_tag for that tag.
Otherwise select all posts.
Sort by created_at, newest first.
Map each row to a summary and load its category names.

components.name: listRevisions
components.purpose: Lists the saved revisions of an entry for the History panel.
components.notes: None
key_logic: Select the revisions of the post.
Sort by created_at, newest first.
Return id, date, and title.

components.name: renameCategory
components.purpose: Changes the name and slug of a category.
components.notes: Old revisions keep the old category name.
components.errors_handled: None. A duplicate name throws a SQLite UNIQUE error.
key_logic: Trim the name.
Update the tag name and its slug.

components.name: reorderCategories
components.purpose: Saves the sidebar order of categories after a drag and drop.
components.data_in: Category ids in the new order
components.notes: The only function in this file that uses a transaction.
key_logic: Start a transaction.
Set sort_order of each id to its list position.
Commit.

components.name: revertToRevision
components.purpose: Restores an entry to an earlier revision, and keeps the current content as a new revision so that the revert can be undone.
components.notes: Media and slug are not restored. Category names that no longer exist are created again.
components.side_effects: May insert into post_revision; updates post; replaces post_tag rows
key_logic: Load the revision. Throw an error when it does not exist.
Compare the current content with the revision.
When they differ, save the current content as a revision.
Write the revision content into the post and set updated_at.
Set the categories from the revision and return the entry.

components.name: setCategoryFavorite
components.purpose: Marks or unmarks a category as a favorite, which moves it to the top of the sidebar.
components.notes: None
key_logic: Convert the flag to 1 or 0.
Update the tag favorite column.

components.name: setPostCategories
components.purpose: Replaces the categories of an entry, and creates any category name that does not exist yet.
components.notes: Categories it creates get sort_order 0, so they sort before older categories.
components.signature: setPostCategories(db: Database.Database, postId: number, categoryNames: string[]): void
components.side_effects: Deletes and inserts post_tag rows; may insert tag rows
key_logic: Delete all post_tag rows of the post.
For each trimmed, non-empty name, insert the tag if it is new.
Find the tag id by name.
Link the post to the tag.

components.name: setPostMedia
components.purpose: Replaces the media list of an entry and deletes files that the entry no longer uses.
components.notes: It deletes files before the new rows are written. A failure after that leaves rows that point to missing files.
components.signature: setPostMedia(db: Database.Database, postId: number, media: PostInput['media']): void
components.side_effects: Deletes files from the media folder; deletes and inserts media rows
components.errors_handled: Ignores files that are already gone
key_logic: Load the current media file names of the post.
Delete each file that is not in the new list.
Delete all media rows of the post.
Insert the new list, with its list position as 'order'.

components.name: snapshotRevision
components.purpose: Saves a copy of the current content of an entry as a revision in its history.
components.notes: Categories are stored as a JSON array of names, so a renamed category keeps its old name in old revisions.
components.errors_handled: Does nothing when the post does not exist
key_logic: Load the title, excerpt, body, cover, caption, and brainstorm of the post.
Stop when the post does not exist.
Insert them as a revision, with the category names as JSON.

components.name: updateBrainstorm
components.purpose: Saves only the brainstorm notes of an entry when the brainstorm panel closes.
components.notes: It does not change updated_at and does not make a revision.
key_logic: Update the brainstorm column of the post with the given id.

components.name: updateCategoryDescription
components.purpose: Saves the description text shown at the top of a category list.
components.notes: An empty description is stored as null.
key_logic: Convert an empty string to null.
Update the tag description.

components.name: updatePost
components.purpose: Saves changes to an entry, and first keeps a revision of the old content when the content changed.
components.notes: A media-only change does not make a revision, because revisions do not store media. An old cover image file is not deleted when the cover changes.
components.side_effects: May insert into post_revision; updates post; replaces post_tag and media rows; deletes media files no longer used
components.errors_handled: None. A duplicate slug throws a SQLite UNIQUE error.
key_logic: Load the current content fields and categories.
When they differ from the input, save a revision of the current content.
Update the post row, including the slug, and set updated_at to now.
Replace its categories and media.
Load and return the entry by its new slug.

components.name: settings.ts
components.purpose: Reads and writes settings.json, with defaults for the user name, the quote bank, the goals, and the theme.
components.notes: Every call reads the file again. There is no cache.

components.name: getSettings
components.purpose: Public read of the current settings for the settings:get IPC channel.
components.notes: None
key_logic: Call readSettings.
Return the result.

components.name: getThemeSource
components.purpose: Gives the saved theme choice so that the main process can restore it at startup.
components.notes: None
key_logic: Read the settings.
Return themeSource.

components.name: readSettings
components.purpose: Loads settings.json and replaces each bad or missing field with its default.
components.notes: An old string value of goals becomes a one-item list.
components.errors_handled: A missing file or a JSON parse error gives DEFAULT_SETTINGS
key_logic: Return the defaults when the file does not exist.
Parse the JSON.
Keep themeSource only when it is system, light, or dark.
Keep userName, quotes, and goals only when their types are correct.
Use the default for every field that fails a check.

components.name: setThemeSource
components.purpose: Saves a new theme choice for the theme:set IPC channel.
components.notes: The caller also sets nativeTheme.themeSource. This function only saves it.
key_logic: Call updateSettings with the new themeSource.

components.name: updateSettings
components.purpose: Merges a partial settings change into the saved settings and writes the file.
components.notes: The patch is not checked. The renderer can write any value.
key_logic: Read the current settings.
Spread the patch over them.
Write the result as JSON.
Return the result.

components.name: Preload bridge
components.purpose: Exposes a typed window.api object to the renderer. Each method forwards to one IPC channel of the main process.
components.data_in: Calls on window.api from the renderer; events from the main process
components.data_out: IPC invoke messages to the main process; promises and callbacks back to the renderer
components.notes: src/preload/index.d.ts declares the Api type for the renderer. It must be kept in step with index.ts by hand. When context isolation is off, the bridge sets window.api directly.
components.start_deploy: Built and loaded together with the main process by electron-vite.
interfaces: window.api (posts, categories, media, theme, settings, onMenu, getVersion)

components.name: index.ts
components.purpose: Builds the api object and exposes it, with electronAPI, on window through contextBridge.
components.data_out: window.api and window.electron in the renderer
components.notes: When contextBridge throws, the error is only logged to the console.

components.name: api
components.purpose: The typed object behind window.api. Each method sends one IPC invoke to the main process and returns its promise.
components.notes: An object literal, not a class. media.getPathForFile is local: it calls webUtils.getPathForFile to get the disk path of a dropped File. The method list must match src/preload/index.d.ts by hand.
components.signature: const api = { getVersion, posts: {...}, categories: {...}, media: {...}, onMenu, theme: {...}, settings: {...} }
components.side_effects: IPC messages to the main process; adds event listeners for onMenu and theme.onUpdate
key_logic: Map each posts method to a posts:* channel.
Map each categories method to a categories:* channel.
Map media.import to media:import, and get file paths with webUtils.
Map theme and settings get/set to their channels.
Let theme.onUpdate and onMenu add listeners and return a remove function.

components.name: api.onMenu
components.purpose: Lets the renderer listen for the New Entry and Save menu commands.
components.data_out: A function that removes the listener
components.notes: Only the two menu channels are allowed, so the renderer cannot listen on other IPC channels.
components.errors_handled: Throws 'Unknown menu channel' for other channels
key_logic: Check that the channel is in MENU_CHANNELS.
Wrap the callback so that it gets no IPC event.
Add the listener.
Return a function that removes it.

components.name: Renderer (React UI)
components.purpose: The React user interface in the app window. It shows the sidebar, home page, entry lists, the entry viewer and editor, and the settings page.
components.data_in: Data from window.api, menu and theme events, user input, dropped files
components.data_out: IPC calls through window.api, the rendered UI
components.notes: index.html sets a Content-Security-Policy that allows images and video only from 'self', data:, and media:. index.css holds the Tailwind setup and the prose-journal styles for rendered Markdown. The @shared alias exists in the Vite config, but the code imports shared types by relative path.
components.technology: TypeScript, React 18, Tailwind CSS 3, Vite 5, marked 18, DOMPurify 3
components.start_deploy: Served by the Vite dev server in 'npm run dev'. Built to out/renderer/ and loaded with loadFile in production.

components.name: App.tsx
components.purpose: The root component. It holds the app-wide state and chooses which page to show.
components.notes: None

components.name: App
components.purpose: Keeps the categories, route, open entry, theme, and settings, and renders the sidebar with the current page.
components.data_in: Categories, settings, and theme from window.api; menu:new-entry events; the Escape key
components.data_out: The rendered app; settings and theme changes through window.api
components.notes: There is no URL router. refreshToken is a counter that makes lists reload after a change.
components.side_effects: IPC calls; toggles the 'dark' class on <html>; adds a keydown listener
key_logic: Load the categories each time refreshToken changes.
Load the settings and theme, and follow theme updates by toggling the 'dark' class.
Open a new entry on the menu:new-entry event.
Close the open entry on Escape and increase refreshToken.
Show EntryPage when an entry is open.
Otherwise show HomeView, SettingsView, or EntryListView for the route.

components.name: components
components.purpose: Reusable UI pieces: the sidebar, entry cards, the category picker, the file drop zone, and small layout helpers.
components.notes: Sidebar is the only component that calls window.api.
components.boundary: Owns shared UI. It must not hold page-level state.

components.name: CategoryPicker.tsx
components.purpose: Checkbox list for choosing the categories of an entry in the editor.
components.notes: None

components.name: CategoryPicker
components.purpose: Lets the user check and uncheck existing categories by name.
components.data_in: All categories, selected names, onChange callback
components.notes: It cannot create categories. The user adds them in the sidebar first.
key_logic: Show a hint when there are no categories.
Show one checkbox for each category.
On toggle, add or remove the name and call onChange.

components.name: Divider.tsx
components.purpose: A styled horizontal rule used between sections and list items.
components.notes: None

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: Renders a thin sage-colored <hr> with extra classes.
components.notes: None
key_logic: Render an <hr> with the border classes and the given className.

components.name: DropZone.tsx
components.purpose: An area that takes files by drag and drop or by a file picker.
components.notes: None

components.name: DropZone
components.purpose: Gives dropped or picked files to the editor for import as cover image or media.
components.data_in: onFiles callback, accept filter, multiple flag, children
components.notes: The accept filter applies only to the file picker, not to dropped files.
components.signature: DropZone({ onFiles, multiple, accept, className, children }): JSX.Element
key_logic: Highlight the area while a file is dragged over it.
On drop, send the dropped files to onFiles.
On click, open a hidden file input.
On pick, send the files to onFiles and clear the input.

components.name: EntryCard.tsx
components.purpose: One entry in a list, with cover thumbnail, date, title, excerpt, and categories.
components.notes: None

components.name: EntryCard
components.purpose: Renders a clickable summary of one entry that opens it by slug.
components.notes: None
components.side_effects: Loads the cover image through media://
key_logic: Show the cover image when there is one.
Show the created date, title, and excerpt.
Show the categories.
Call onOpen with the slug on click.

components.name: FadeIn.tsx
components.purpose: A wrapper that fades its content in when it scrolls into view.
components.notes: None

components.name: FadeIn
components.purpose: Shows its children with a fade and slide once they become visible.
